tw-wi-palmyra-blackmore-shack-1927.st: AP, 19 Feb 1927: more than $5,000 had been found. It included gold notes of 1863 and soldered pipes of gold coin under a floor board ($588 in one find). Villagers tore up the floors, walls and the swamp around the shack, and the sheriff posted guards. The surviving brother went to England.
src: AP, 19 Feb 1927 (Chronicling America, via County-depth thread SE WI sweep; research/treasure-statewide/sewi-chronam-2026-11-01.md)
